svg.title: Choose the first available placement source
svg.desc: WinUI first uses a valid non-null CustomPlacement. Otherwise it can cascade from an open, visible same-ID window when cascading is allowed and the reason is not ApplicationRestart. Next it tries usable WinUI saved placement. ID-based cascading and loading require package identity and a nonempty PlacementId. If no source applies, WinUI uses requested Width or Height values, or retains existing and OS defaults if neither dimension is set. Invalid caller input reports an error rather than falling through this chain.
svg.text: Choose the first available placement source
WinUI uses the first available source and rejects invalid caller input.
2. Open, visible window with the same PlacementId
Package identity and nonempty ID; cascading allowed; not ApplicationRestart.
Package identity and nonempty ID; a usable record loads.
No source above; use the fallback dimensions the app set.
A missing or unusable saved record permits fallback; it is not an invalid Apply call.
